name: Royal Game of Ur
description: The world's oldest known board game (~2600 BC, Sumer). Two players race 7 pieces around an asymmetric 20-square H-shaped board. Movement is driven by FOUR TETRAHEDRAL DICE — each die has 2 marked corners and 2 unmarked corners; only the top counts, so each die is effectively a coin flip and the sum (0–4) follows Binomial(4, ½). Rolling 0 forfeits the turn. Landing on a ROSETTE (5 special squares marked with a star pattern) grants safety from capture AND an extra throw. The central shared rosette is the strategic linchpin. Pieces in the shared middle row can capture opponents (sending them back to start) — except on the central rosette. First player to bear off all 7 pieces wins.

phases.name: play
phases.description: Players alternate turns. White moves first. Landing on a rosette grants an extra turn for the same player.

entity_types.name: UrPlayer
entity_types.description: A Royal Game of Ur player. Reads the board, rolls the dice, then chooses which piece to advance.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Side: 'white' (moves first) or 'black'. Assigned by seat order.

properties.name: pieces_at_start
properties.description: Pieces not yet entered on the board (waiting to be placed).

properties.name: pieces_borne_off
properties.description: Pieces successfully borne off the end of the path.

properties.name: risk_tolerance
properties.description: 0 = avoids landing on shared row when capture is likely; 1 = pushes pieces into the battle zone aggressively.

actions.name: roll_dice
actions.description: Roll the four tetrahedral dice. Result is 0–4 (Binomial(4, ½) — most rolls are 1–3, rolls of 0 and 4 are uncommon). Must be called at the start of every sub-turn. Takes no parameters.

actions.name: move_piece
actions.description: After rolling, advance ONE of your pieces by the rolled amount. REQUIRED parameter `from` (integer): 0 = bring a new piece onto the board (it lands at position `roll`); 1..14 = the path position of the piece you want to move (it advances by `roll`). `from` MUST appear in `legal_from_positions` from your perception. Bearing off requires an EXACT roll (piece at pos 14 needs roll 1, pos 13 needs roll 2, etc.) — overshooting is illegal.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Path position of the piece to move (0 = enter a new piece from off-board, 1..14 = path position of an existing piece).

actions.name: pass_turn
actions.description: Explicitly forfeit your roll when no legal move is possible (the engine surfaces this option only when `legal_from_positions` is empty after a non-zero roll).

agent_archetypes.name: Aggressive Racer
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Pushes pieces forward fast, accepts trades and captures to get to bear-off first. Likes the central rosette for its safety + extra turn.

agent_archetypes.name: Defensive Strategist
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Avoids the shared row except when safe rosettes are reachable. Develops a wall of two pieces on adjacent squares to block opponent captures.

agent_archetypes.name: Balanced Tactician
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Adapts to the position. Calculates expected pip counts (roll distribution centered at 2). Looks for high-value captures on the shared row while maintaining defensive structure on private squares.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Players
runtime_parameters.description: Royal Game of Ur is strictly 2 players (one White, one Black).

runtime_parameters.name: premise
runtime_parameters.label: Scenario Premise
runtime_parameters.description: Optional framing — e.g. 'Bronze Age temple tournament' or 'British Museum exhibition match'.

termination_conditions.name: all_borne_off
termination_conditions.description: End the game when a player bears off all 7 pieces.

termination_conditions.name: resignation
termination_conditions.description: End the game when a player resigns.
